## Annotation

Section 4.C requires health authorities to fund CSIL as a self-directed alternative to agency home support. It defines CSIL employer, client support group, CSIL representative, CSIL agreement, and CSIL funds. Clients who cannot always direct their own care may participate through a support group or representative. A grandfathering sentence states that clients receiving CSIL funding as of 31 March 2011 remain eligible after 1 April 2011 regardless of later 4.C.2 criteria.

The 2008 synthesis cited an April 2007 *Home & Community Care Policy Manual* (sections 5.A). Chapter numbering has changed. The 2007 manual was not recovered in this pass.
